_README: Machine-readable failure register. The single source of truth for the FMEA,
the FTA cut sets, and the diagnostic-coverage calculation.
S, O and D are ORDINAL JUDGEMENT SCALES (1-10), NOT probabilities. They are
ranks assigned by the analyst. RPN = S x O x D is therefore a SORTING
HEURISTIC, not a risk quantity, and it may not be read as one. Multiplying
three ordinal scales produces a number whose units do not exist.
The only figure in this file that is a real measurement is diagnostic
coverage, and it is a COUNT over this register: how many dangerous failure
modes have a rung-1 gate behind them. scripts/fmeda_coverage.py computes it.
rung: 1 = code that blocks and is itself tested
2 = a declared test, not yet run against reality
3 = prose only; depends on a person remembering
